mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux, potentially increasing colchicine levels and risk of toxicity; haloperidol may also enhance neuromuscular effects.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity signs (GI symptoms, myopathy, neuropathy); consider dose reduction of colchicine or alternative antipsychotic; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
